entries.why: NEW IN THIS TICKET — the dedicated Service planning section the founder asked for, holding the order of service, the volunteer rota and the invitations. Recorded so a later ticket that edits it fails in ITS OWN PR rather than silently inheriting THE-326's shape. It mounts ServicePlanPanel, VolunteerRotaPanel and RotaInvitePanel and adds one thing of its own: the picker that says WHICH dated service the run sheet is for, which the event detail screen used to supply implicitly.

THE-326 REMOVES service planning from this screen and adds nothing to it: the ServicePlanPanel mount, the whole 'rota' view with both its panels, the 'Volunteer rota' button, the 'rota' arm of the header-override effect, three imports and 'rota' from the ViewMode union. Events keeps the list, the month view, create/edit/detail and registrations — the public-facing event product. Recorded here as the state this ticket leaves the file in; THE-308's month view and THE-313's write paths are unchanged and are pinned separately by region digest in the-308-guards.test.ts.

Two visible defects fixed, both measured in Chromium and neither of them a shape change. First, the tab labels overlapped: 'Not served recently' needed 115px of scrollWidth inside a 91px clientWidth with nowrap and overflow visible, because min-w-[44px] on the triggers overrode the flex min-width:auto content floor; the class is gone and the list is w-full. Second, the date selector rendered the raw epoch 1788513540000, because Select.Value with no children prints the VALUE; it now formats through fmtDay, the same function its own options already used. No prop, call, write or query moved.
